svg.title: Defense Industry vs. Market Returns (1973–2020)
svg.desc: This chart compares annual returns of the defense industry (black line) with the overall market (yellow line) from 1973 to 2020. While both follow similar long-term trends, the defense sector often outperforms during periods of volatility or geopolitical tension. The market shows sharper dips—especially around economic downturns—while the defense industry maintains more consistent gains, highlighting its relative resilience and counter-cyclical behavior within the broader economy.
